content: Morning! What should today look like?

Your recovery signals look stable—Form was +7 yesterday, with steady HRV/resting HR and 7.5 hours’ sleep—so today can be aerobic work.

Warmup: 10min easy, building from Z1 to Z2  
Main: 50min steady Z2 (56–75% FTP), conversational effort  
Cooldown: 10min Z1 (<55% FTP)  

Estimated intensity: 0.65–0.70  
Estimated Load: 45–55  

Why: solid century-specific aerobic volume without creating excessive Monday fatigue. If you feel unusually heavy, shorten the main block to 30min.
